blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: Jack and his mother were poor, so Jack gave their cow for some magic beans. A giant beanstalk grew, and Jack climbed it to a giant's castle, where he took a hen that laid golden eggs. When the giant followed him, Jack chopped down the beanstalk, and he and his mother were safe.
Jack gave the cow for some beans. She thought it was a foolish trade.

items.q: What did Jack see in the giant's castle?
items.model: He saw many treasures: gold and a hen that laid golden eggs.

items.q: How did Jack stop the giant?
items.model: He chopped the beanstalk with an axe. The giant fell down with a mighty crash.

items.q: Would you climb the beanstalk? Why or why not?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: Jack took the cow down the road
Jack gave the cow for some magic beans
A giant beanstalk grew outside the cottage
Jack took the hen and ran
